settings.heading: Return policyHow do I use the Smilie Teeth Whitening Kit?

settings.text:
Start by charging your LED device for one hour before your first use. Brush and dry your teeth, then apply the whitening gel to the front of your top and bottom teeth using the precision brush. Apply an even, generous layer by brushing from the top of each tooth downwards.

Next, place the mouthpiece in your mouth and gently close your lips around the device. Press the button to switch it on and whiten for 16–30 minutes. When finished, remove the mouthpiece, spit out any excess saliva, and rinse your mouth with water. Rinse the device with water (or gentle hand soap for a deeper clean), dry, and place back into the holder for storage.

For best results, use once daily for 7 days. After your initial treatment, maintain your smile with a quick touch-up every two weeks or as needed.

settings.heading: What makes the Smilie Boost Whitening Kit different?

settings.text: The Smilie Boost Whitening Kit is designed with the same professional-grade ingredients dentists use, but at a lower and safer concentration - so you get effective whitening without harshness. What truly sets it apart is the added Potassium Nitrate, a proven ingredient that helps calm and protect sensitive teeth while you whiten. This means you don’t just get a brighter smile - you get it comfortably, without the pain that many other whitening kits can cause.

settings.heading: How Often Should I Use My Kit and for how long?

settings.text: Use your Smilie kit once a day for 16–30 minutes over a period of 7–21 days, depending on your whitening goals. If you experience sensitivity, simply pause for 1–3 days and then continue your treatments

settings.heading: Is Smilie okay to use if I have sensitive teeth?

settings.text: While every smile is unique, Smilie products are formulated with sensitivity in mind. The majority of our customers whiten comfortably without experiencing sensitivity
